description: This file is a script that scans project files to build a web search provider boundary inventory for security or structural analysis. It imports utility modules, defines functions to traverse directories, parse files, and generate an inventory of web search provider boundaries as well as compare to expected baseline data. The main function runs the inventory collection and diff check.

methods.name: walkFiles
methods.description: Recursively walks through directories starting from rootDir, returning a list of file paths with specific extensions, excluding ignored directories.

methods.name: compareInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries, used for sorting.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds a new inventory entry to the inventory list after verifying the provider id.

methods.name: scanWebSearchProviderRegistry
methods.description: Scans lines of a registry file to find provider registrations based on certain string patterns and regex matches, pushing entries into inventory accordingly.

methods.name: scanGenericCoreImports
methods.description: Scans lines of files for import patterns related to web search providers outside allowed files, recording those in inventory.

methods.name: collectWebSearchProviderBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Asynchronously collects inventory data across project files, excluding ignored files, returning a sorted list of boundary entries.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads and parses the baseline inventory JSON file, returns an empty array if file does not exist.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Calculates differences between the expected and actual inventory.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a string.

methods.name: runWebSearchProviderBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the baseline inventory check process, comparing actual inventory to expected, and formats the results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that executes the boundary check and exits with status code.
